thread:
alex: quick ping — PR #1023 (refactor/kv-cache-naming) has a couple style nits from kai. can someone take a 5‑min pass? ci passes locally but want to tidy before merge.

maria: i'll take it. which nits specifically?

kai: mostly var/func names and one formatting nit. example: `ctx` -> `context` in public APIs, and an unused `fmt` import in `pkg/cache.go`. also trailing whitespace on lines ~42-44.

alex: thanks. i can push a fix shortly — do we want to keep api backwards-compat? public surface is small but better to rename before release.

cheng: if it's purely internal, i prefer `ctx`. for exported funcs expanding to `context` makes sense. looks like a mix in this PR.

maria: ok i'll prepare a tiny commit: expand param names on exported funcs, run `gofmt`, and remove the stray import. will also trim trailing spaces.

maria: pushed fix in branch `refactor/kv-cache-naming` (commit 8a7b2d1) — renamed exported params to `context`, removed `fmt`, trimmed whitespace. ptal. ci kicked off.

dev-bot: CI — build passed; unit tests passed; lint: 1 warning (unused var in tests).

kai: lgtm apart from the unused var in `cache_test.go` (line ~27) — there's `tmp :=` left over. could you remove that? otherwise approve.

maria: good catch, removed in 8a7b2d2 and re-ran linters.

dev-bot: linter passed. build passed.

alex: approving now. @cheng can you give a final +1 on the naming choice? planning to merge after 30m if no objections.

cheng: +1 from me, happy with the exported names.

ops-bot: merge window opens at 2026-03-17 15:00 UTC; recommend waiting for canary deploy, not blocking the merge.

alex: noted — i'll merge in 10m and watch canary. thanks all :tada: :pray:

maria: nice, thanks. filed follow-up issue #1045 for docstring examples and a small test cleanup.

alex: merged PR #1023 (merge commit 3f9c1a0). monitoring metrics now.

maria: thanks — no regressions in canary after 20m. i'll backfill a changelog entry.

alex: great. closing thread.
